topic: Apple unveils iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone
details: Confirmed at Apple's Sept 9 2026 'Surprise and Shine' keynote (Ternus's first as CEO). Payoff to our earlier rumor reels (iphone-fold-ultra, apple-surprise-and-shine, apple-8-products-september) which all guessed at name/price/specs. Now official: name is iPhone Duo (not Ultra/Fold as rumored), 7.6in inner + 5.4in outer displays, A20 Pro, Touch ID in side button, dual battery, titanium, eSIM-only, starts $1999, preorder Oct 16, ships Oct 23.
